notes.title: PS4 Release, Community Vote Results and More
notes.notes:
General!

Our ever-vigilant intelligence service has prepared a news update, for your eyes only!
Here are all of our spy’s key findings.

Strategic Mind series is now available
on PS4

On August 5th Strategic Mind: The Pacific and Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg became available on the PS store. The PS porting and publishing on consoles is done by our partners from Poland - Klabater. Here is a tweet by the Klabater CEO Michał Gembicki:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31809087/1ddb98002716930ad3f2e3a9d9f5ed162772d983.png

We hope that the release on PS will be successful. As far as we are concerned the XBOX release will follow at a later date. 


Community Vote Results

Two weeks ago we announced the community vote for the historical tracks that would be created for the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty soundtrack. Now we are back with the results. We have carefully collected all the votes across Steam community hubs. We will list all the counted votes authors at the end of the post and we would like to give them a free copy of the Strategic Mind Franchise Soundtrack. Read more:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1474770/announcements/detail/2976301985164724802

New episode of Developer’s Gameplay is out!

Did you watch our latest episode of the Developer's gameplay series? This time it is the Battle of Dunkirk - the 3rd operation of the UK campaign. This is an operation like none the other - since you have to defend against overwhelming German force and allow for the Allied troops' organized evacuation by sea. Watch the latest Dev gameplay episode: 

[previewyoutube=LQr8E3fd7Fc;full][/previewyoutube]

New Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom gameplay on YouTube by Edmon

Not all playthroughs are successful on the first run. And our friend Edmon has failed his first attempt at the Battle of Dunkirk on Insurmountable difficulty. It is always better to learn from others' mistakes, so we highly recommend his playthrough. Here is the list of episodes:

Hello, guys!

There is only one day left before the Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom release, and we are ready to start Starni games release celebration with nice discounts for all our previous titles. Do not worry - we will add Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom to the Strategic Mind Complete Collection bundle - and if you have all other titles, you would be able to get it alone with a 20% bundle discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16499/Strategic_Mind_Complete_Collection/
Starni Games x Klabater cooperation

Today, we have a special event in store for you. Last year we partnered with the Klabater company to produce and publish console ports for the Strategic Mind: The Pacific and Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg. So, the Klabater team is hard at work producing the ports and plan to have them ready later this year. 

Starting 20 May there will be a week-long Klabater publisher sale on Steam and they kindly invited us to participate as their partners with the Strategic Mind series. While we are in charge of the PC publishing, the console release will be done by the Klabater team and we all are rooting for its success. We will keep you informed about the console porting progress.

Klabater publisher sale on Steam will last from 20 to 27 May and will feature many interesting titles - so, we invite you to check it out:

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/sale/klabater

It is really interesting how the event has almost coincided with the Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom release, so we decided to combine our release celebration with the Klabater event. We are really thankful to the Klabater team for offering us this great opportunity.

Please, let us know what you think of this idea and which cool games you found at a discount there. 

🔥 Do miss the Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom release tomorrow at 19.00 CET (10.00 am PDT).
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850/Strategic_Mind_Fight_for_Freedom/

notes.title: 8 Days to Release - Douglas A-1 Skyraider The US Attack Aircraft
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/735bfbb3c9f0ef7335b2984bba27902e6dad1c28.png

In the age of the turbojet, Douglas A-1 Skyraider flew as a piston-powered, propeller-driven blast from the past. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/12bda2c534d744d6812578cee65c8d21ee4a0737.jpg

With the rapid development of jet aircraft towards the end of the war, dozens, if not hundreds of piston engine aircraft became obsolete. The Skyraider could have joined their lot, but its innovative turbo-compound engine gave it a chance to prove itself - and prove itself it did.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/500fbb2065c7709ed3a10144dbf984b50aac36e8.jpg

A solid, well-made and innovative at a time, Douglas A-1 would last well into the Vietnam War, only decommissioned in the 1970s. It was an attack aircraft that could shred ground targets with its 20-mm autocannons, carry out tactical bombings (with its payload capacity of 3600 kg) and deliver torpedo strikes equally well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/474ae69218b59df3733695829d035bdb30e3b894.jpg

There is no telling how effective Douglas A-1 would have been in WWII if it were finalized and deployed faster. And in Fight for Freedom, you’ll get to explore that exact possibility.

https://media.giphy.com/media/VwtOcFY2RCm98EZ3dN/giphy-downsized-large.gif

notes.title: Victory in Europe Day - Free Demo Update 8 May
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/5118c29e7556e9dbbae33d83f371a28db1a6c3fd.png

Victory in Europe Day

General! We would like to celebrate V-E Day by uploading a new Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom Demo build for free. So, now everyone can enjoy the game and live through the epochal events, such as the Normandy landings.

We are immensely grateful to all the valiant soldiers who fought in WW2 and brought the World age of peace and prosperity. Now, we can see the horrors of massive conflicts only in games, and we get to choose which games to play. We think there is a lot to be learned about our society and human nature in general by studying the events of WW2 - and what better way of immersing oneself in these events than to become an active participant, even if only in the game. 

The New Demo

The new Demo has around 5 hours of gameplay - the first operations of both the UK and the US campaigns. Overall the build runs great and there should not be any serious technical issues. There is some stuff that we still have to iron out, especially in localizations and cinematics, so the most vigilant players may notice some issues, but we are working day and night to correct everything before release, so do not worry - we will do our best to correct all possible shortcomings. In fact, if you notice anything weird - make sure to let us know at our community hub - and we will do our best to fix it asap. 

The Game Release - 21 May

The full game will be released on 21 May 2021, so there are only two weeks left. Wishlist Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom, so that you do not miss its launch. 

📍 Important notes: 
 You can use Demo save files when you play the full game. So, you could covert your Demo progress into a full game on its full launch on 21 May.
 You can post any materials without restrictions.

👉 Pay the Demo by following this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=demo_update
Have a good weekend!

Starni Games team

“We are happy to announce the release date for Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom. When we started working on the Strategic Mind series back in 2018 our goal was to cover all major powers in WW2, and now we are finally close to that goal.” - says Ihor Tymoshenko, the CEO of Starni Games.

Free Demo Update
We know that you have been waiting for it, and want it to released as soon as possible, so to make your wait more pleasant we will update the Free Demo for the game on 8 May 2021 - Victory in Europe Day - so that you will be able to play the first operations of both UK and USA campaigns for free with sound and cinematics. We hope that it will keep you occupied until the full release comes on 21 May and will be a great celebration of the civilized world victory in WW2. 

All Strategic Mind series titles update
Additionally, all our previous Strategic Mind titles are getting an overhaul to be compatible with the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom - which includes upgraded tutorials, bug fixes, and other quality of life improvements. The update is planned for the last days of April. 

Let’s turn May 2021 into a wargamer’s holiday!
We hope that we can turn the preparations for the release into a true wargamer’s holiday with lots of stuff going on both in terms of news about the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom and in terms of the content available to you throughout the next month. 

Community support matters
Please, let us know your thoughts in the comments! We have already implemented lots of features based on community feedback and will keep doing so to the best of our ability. Thus, you can be sure that your voice matters and all you need to do is give us meaningful feedback and wait for us to implement your suggestion. Together we can build the best wargame possible. 

Do not miss it
Make sure you wishlist and follow Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom to stay up to date with all the upcoming announcements:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=community&utm_medium=web

Subscribe to our newsletter to gain exclusive wallpapers and other good stuff by the end of April. Subscribe to newsletter here.

notes.title: How is the full version of Strategic Mind: The Pacific planned to differ from the EA version?
notes.notes:
We want to keep you informed about how our work progresses. So, here is the table representing the comparison of our expectations for the Early access version (at launch, April 30) and the Full release version of the game.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Features[/th]
        [th]Early access (April 30)[/th]
        [th]Full release[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Core content[/th]
        [th]First 3 operations of the USA campaign[/th]
        [th]2 full campaigns: the USA and the Empire of Japan[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Estimated playtime[/th]
        [th]10 hours[/th]
        [th]60+ hours[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Cutscenes[/th]
        [th]None (work in progress)[/th]
        [th]Before and after each operation[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Voice acting[/th]
        [th]None (only text)[/th]
        [th]Full [/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Rewards[/th]
        [th]Full (for 3 operations)[/th]
        [th]Full[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Units[/th]
        [th]Full (for 3 operations)[/th]
        [th]Full[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Units progression[/th]
        [th]Full (for 3 operations)[/th]
        [th]Full[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Units skills[/th]
        [th]90% ready[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]HQ skills [/th]
        [th]50% ready[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Equipment[/th]
        [th]50% ready[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Icons[/th]
        [th]50% ready[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Core mechanics[/th]
        [th]100% ready (some rework and polishing might be needed)[/th]
        [th]100% ready and polished[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Day/night and rain[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
        [th]100% ready[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Heroes[/th]
        [th]None (at launch)[/th]
        [th]All[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Let us go over the main points and provide you with more detail.

As many of you could have guessed, cutscenes require lots of effort. We have already done the script and other preliminary work, however, there are still much to do in this regard. So we do not expect them to be ready before the full release.

The similar situation exists regarding the voice acting. We have to finalise all the lines before making and implementing voice acting.

All units and rewards for Early access are already in the game. As well as most of the skills.

HQ skills, equipment and icons are work in progress.

Core mechanics are ready, but require additional testing and polishing both before and after the beginning of Early access stage.
Day/night and rain features are now being tested.

We plan to add heroes after the beginning of Early access as the work progresses and we deal with more crucial elements of the game.

We hope that this portion of content will help you understand what to expect from the Full version of the game (apart from cutscenes). And, on the other hand, your feedback would help us make the Full version even better.

We want our development process to be as transparent as possible without spoiling too much of the actual game. We want you to be informed about our work, but at the same time keep some surprises in store for the time when you will finally be able to launch the game.

Add Strategic Mind: The Pacific to your Wishlist on Steam! The store page is live already: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/991810/Strategic_Mind_The_Pacific/

notes.title: Patch v1.22 of 03 December 2018
notes.notes:
Major fixes:

 Fixed major problem with “fatal error” when loading certain save files. Now it will not affect save files in future AND we were able to make save files already affected work. So you can just load any save file you have and it should work correctly. PSB-2440 
 Fixed paratroopers being able to move into hex with another land unit in it under some circumstances. PSB-2441
 Fixed problem which sometimes caused seemingly random crashes on Norway map during AI turns. PSB-2442

Gameplay changes and other fixes:

 Paratroopers and marines cannot disembark on rough terrain anymore. Now the only eligible tiles are “clear” and “desert”. PSB-2413 
 One tile on Norway map was changed from rough to clear to allow disembarkation. PSB-2411
 Now when you choose a ship gun you can see its attack in parameters as a base value instead of bonus. (“16” instead of “0+16”)
 Fixed aircrafts being able to use Altitude ability while on the airfield. 
 Now when you click outside deploy hexes during deploy, it would not cause deploy hexes to disappear (you had to click on some unit to turn them back on). PSB-2393
 Now when you click on an allied unit which cannot be redeployed during deploy phase the “Reserve” tab will automatically switch to “Army” tab. PSB-2368

notes.title: Patch v1.21b of 29 November 2018
notes.notes:

Major fixes:

 Fixed fatal errors occuring at various moments of the game. 

Many thanks to everyone who helped us immensely by reporting this issue. We hope that you can now continue playing unperturbed. 

Please let us know of any remaining issues and we will do our best to address them in due time.

notes.title: Patch v1.21 of 28 November 2018
notes.notes:
Fixes and improvements:

 IMPORTANT: Fixed major bug with saves being unavailable after restarting the game if OS username contains any letters or symbols other than Latin (Eg. Russian or German letters). 

Now prestige gained from captured enemies is added immediately (instead of after the mission) and it cannot be affected by your losses. (Same as capturing enemy positions)

Now when your unit captures the enemy unit, you can see the amount of prestige you gain above your unit. (Same as when you capture a hex with an enemy flag in it)  PSB-2396 

Fixed some inaccuracies with heroes tab. PSB-2416

Fixed units onboard a train unable to leave it on the same hex it is currently on. PSB-2089

Fixed next unit not being auto selected when deploying paratroopers onboard a plane. PSB-2386

Fixed “Sluggish” flying label being green (instead of red) PSB-2397

Fixed demoralised units being able to attack. PSB-2395

Changed the format of unit names in the lower part of UI to match unit information screen. Now it is always “class”:”model”. (Eg. Tank: Pz. IV) PSB-2406


* This list does not include some of the issues solved and inaccuracies fixed.

notes.title: Patch v1.20 of 20 November 2018
notes.notes:
Major changes

New saving system. (Now all saves are separate files (instead of one big file with info about all saves) and are stored in the following default folder on your PC C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\Local\StarniGames\PanzerStrategy. 

Please note that “AppData” is a hidden folder. So, now you can copy, delete etc individual saves or any number of them as it suits you. Back up your saves and so on (now you can safely uninstall the game without losing save files). 

This change, however, came at a cost. We managed to preserve your saves made during the strategic phase of the game (between missions), but unfortunately the saves made during any given mission before this patch are now unavailable. 

Also note that all land vehicles (ground transport) attached to units were sold and their cost in prestige added to your prestige, so you can buy them back. We are sorry to disrupt your gameplay and hope that availability of strategic phase saves will curb the damage. We were anxious to make this step as we did not want to disappoint our players. However, we understood that there were no other way to move forward without this painful step. 

This new system is a huge step toward adopting steam cloud saves as well as better steam integration and other juicy stuff in future. It also helped us fix some of the existing issues and prevent some future problems before they came.

We hope that you will forgive us this inconvenience for the sake of unhindered future development of the game.

Added “Continue” button in main menu PSB-2209 
Added quick save/quick load (F5/F8) PSB-2116
Command Points gain per turn now depends on the number of deployed core units. (Instead of core units) So, now you can omit deploying part of your army in certain missions to ensure more Command points income per turn.  PSB-2367
Fixed not playing cutscene after Operation Sea Lion. PSB-2247
Major rework of damage distribution when attacking ships.
Now damage is distributed more evenly among all ship parts and hull. So, you basically need to wipe out all ship modules before you can sink a ship|(in most cases), unless you use torpedoes (which always damage only hull). 

Torpedoes now do not apply statistic reduction, and reduce movement of the ship by 1. We are eager to let you try out the new damage distribution system, as we think it provides major increase in tactical thinking required for successful naval battles and reduces their randomness by huge margin. PSB-2345

Vulnerability mechanic has been removed from the game. (In previous versions ship`s AA guns, depth charges and torpedo tubes received x2 damage.)
Ships and submarines now can resupply their ammo and fuel at seaports. (You have to move them within 1 hexagon of a seaport.) PSB-2035
Fixed capital ships BuildIn skill "Barrage fire".  Now it attacks (only) once with one of its secondary guns.) PSB-2309
Added line of fire for artillery. All artillery units: ship guns, land artillery and coastal batteries now cannot attack enemy units obstructed by mountain (and unpassable mountain) terrain. New label “No line of fire” indicates that you cannot fire at that target from current position due to terrain factor. PSB-2288
Air units (fighters and bombers) can now move 1 hex after being stopped mid air with overwatch ability (eg. AA overwatch fire).  PSB-2258, PSB-2293
Fighters now can move 1 hex after attacking land units. (Same as bombers. Note that it does not allow them to move after attacking air targets) PSB-2280
Fixed coastal artillery. Now it works similar to Forts. PSB-2065 Coastal artillery now has range 3 (in its zone of fire). Beware! PSB-2297
Increased defense bonus for units if the enemy has no full information about the unit. If the unit is unknown (no unit type info, shown by ? on the map) defense increased by 4 (it was 2).  If the unit is spotted (its type is known, shown by ?? in place of unit strength) defense increased by 2 (it was 1) PSB-2261
Added info (flying label) "Unidentified target: damage reduced" when firing at unidentified (unknown or spotted, see above)) unit.  PSB-2243
 Minimum entrenchment level for CloseDefence to apply increased from 3 to 4. (It means infantry has to be better entrenched to use CloseDefence parameter of armored units in combat. Makes armored units stronger vs infantry in certain situations.) PSB-2263
 Bombers now can return fire even if they have no ammo left. (It is the only type of units in the game which does not use its ammo for return fire, and uses it only for attacks.) PSB-1957
 Fixed support mechanics to check not only units attack value but also their current strength when choosing the most powerful unit to provide support. 

When two or more units are eligible for support at the same time) Now ships AA guns would not support if there is fighter to provide support. (Ship`s AA has more air attack then fighter, but only 2 strength. So it would support only if there is a fighter with 2-3 hp contesting right to support) Same applies for artillery etc. PSB-2254

 You can now see Build In Skills (skills which are same for all units of that class) (Do not confuse it with Level Up Skills which are chosen during level ups - those are seen only if you have full info about the enemy unit( as before)) of an enemy unit if it is spotted (unknown strength), earlier it was shown only if you have full information about unit. PSB-2211
 Rebalanced activation costs of HQ skills: Aviation recon and Blitzkrieg +1 activation cost, Tank onslaught - unchanged, Frontline artillery -1 activation cost, Strategic bombing -1 activation cost.
 Added info (flying label) "Initiative won" when unit wins initiative contest. (It is always attacking unit. If it wins initiative, it still attacks second (unless it has First Strike ability) but gains +4 to defence for the time of enemy counter attack.  PSB-2256
 Some positive (eg. unit is entrenched; or it is near HQ) and negative (eg. unit is in the river; or it was already attacked this turn) effects on units are now also displayed via a green or red icon (tick) on the unit. (You still can see all the effects in unit parameters window) The “ticks” stuck up to 3 and if the number of effects is higher then there is number under the “tick” going up. (Ticks usually show number of effects, the only exceptions are entrenchment and previous attacks where each level of entrenchment or each attack adds a separate “tick”. PSB-2289, PSB-2300, PSB-2302, PSB-2328, PSB-2337
 Some hot keys effects are now shown via text on the screen. PSB-1589
 Added symbol (<<) "Upgrade available" during the strategic screen. It is shown when there are new models available in this type of units after the last mission.  PSB-2269

Other fixes and improvements

 Fixed: Air units no longer gain bonuses (+4 to defence, +1 camouflage) when they are in a hex with building (eg. in Dunkirk or Stalingrade map) as if it was an infantry occupying that building.
 Bombers now do not counterattack with bombing if the enemy ship is attacking them with AA gun from underneath (same hex, range 0). PSB-2375
 Changed flying labels for damage to various ship parts. Now they reflect the type of part (eg. Anti-Aircraft Gun, Secondary Gun, Torpedo Tube) instead of exact part name (eg. 2 x 37 mm 50 Mle, 8 x 105 mm SKC/33, 4 x G7a 533 mm) Also, now damage to the ship hull is marked as “-x Hull” instead of plain “-x”. If not a single ship part took damage from an attack, “0” is shown.
 Fixed torpedo tube with 0 hp being able to attack (for 0 damage) and put a -1 penalty for previous attack on the enemy. (Now it cannot be used) PSB-2291
 Fixed torpedo tubes being able to shoot at the enemy ship through 1 hex of land PSB-2362
 Torpedo tubes now cannot shoot at the enemy ship through a hex with another friendly or enemy ship. PSB-2377
 Fixed train (and some other auxiliary units) having 0 spotting range. PSB-2343
 Now units do not lose entrenchment levels if they attack without moving into another hex. (So you can now attack units next to the entrenched unit without losing its entrenchment) PSB-2356
 Now after deploying one unit, next unit on the list is auto selected. (Earlier the first unit on the list was auto selected) PSB-2301
 Fixed “Commissar” skill having no description. PSB-2222
 Fixed “Poorly trained” skill having no description. PSB-2223
 Fixed LinkedFight bug when you could use this ability before movement and then move.(Which is illegal due to LinkedFight description) PSB-2251
 Fixed infantry on board a train being able to entrench. PSB-2339
 In Battle for Atlantic mission fixed bug with rain effects lasting long after the rain has finished. PSB-2364
 Fixed paratroopers in the air (transportation) gaining full fuel after save/load. PSB-2084
 Fixed incorrect display of fuel (shown as full) and movement left (shown as max) of units in transportation mode after save/load. PSB-2195
 Fixed icon for paratroopers disembarking from a ship (it was shown as a parachute as if they were disembarking from plane) PSB-2143
 Fixed message when trying to disembark at seaport with all eligible hexes being already occupied. (It was saying you have to disembark at seaport) PSB-2144
 Fixed message when trying to disembark at enemy controlled seaport. It was saying you have to disembark at seaport. PSB-2148
 Fixed all AI embarked landing forces in Norway on “Marshall” difficulty level having 10 strength instead of 12. PSB-2366
 Added "Click for detailed info" when you mouse hover over units parameters. PSB-2257
 Fixed incorrect info “You do not have enough HQ points to learn a new HQ skill” after you already learned all levels of that skill. PSB-2182
 Fixed minor bug with leveling up units skills PSB-2181
 Fixed reinforcement of units cost 0 prestige while unit is on the train.  PSB-2121
 Fixed some issues with support firing range for certain units. PSB-2086
 If you have AirRecon or AirStrike skill selected and choose where on the map to apply it, you now can cancel it by left clicking any allied unit. PSB-2152
 Double clicking on the unit in “Reserve” tab will now center the camera on the nearest deploy hex. PSB-2281
 Added info “Available between missions” for icons of increase/decrease unit strength”(-/+) and “disband” on units during the mission. PSB-2017
 Added infohints for icons of increase/decrease unit strength”(-/+) and “disband” on units during the strategic screen and deploy phase. PSB-2017
 Added visual effect for new secondary objective when you get it during the mission. PSB-2190
 Fixed Rommel “Aggressive” skill tooltip description (changed “+2 initiative from HQ” to “Erwin Rommel: gain +2 initiative”) not to be misleading. 
 Fixed water animation shown in incorrect hexes when moving ships. PSB-2162
 Fixed some problems with water animation. PSB-1860
 Fixed unit with less than 0 hp (took more damage than had hp) lingering too long before disappearing if you skip animation. PSB-2298
 Fixed some city hexes on Dunkirk map not having city name on them. PSB-2179
 Fixed various text inaccuracies in English and Russian versions of the game.
 Fixed flying label for ships BarrageFire skill activation displaying incorrect text in Russian localisation. PSB-2213

* This list does not include some of the issues solved and inaccuracies fixed.

- Shot effects have been changed;
- The issue when a player may attach a hero to several units fixed.

We are continuing to work on technical issues from the player's reports and new content. Thank you for your support and feedback!

Best regards,
Panzer Strategy team

notes.title: Panzer Strategy gets a massive update: a new scenario, updated graphics, performance improvements and a lot more
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/RPtBQqV.jpg
On May 17 a massive update for Panzer Strategy rolls out!

It is bringing a whole new scenario ‘Operation Weserübung’, improved visuals, new units, a better AI, as well as numerous technical improvements. Panzer Strategy, currently on Steam Early Access, now features three full scenarios, latest Unreal Engine 4 graphics, and a lot more stable and polished gameplay with lots of content – moving the game closer to the final version quality. 

The updated Panzer Strategy Early Access trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ijdi-XGsqU0
About ‘Operation Weserübung’ game scenario

The new scenario in the update is ‘Operation Weserübung’ – it is a Wehrmacht operation in Norway carried out between April 9 and June 8, 1940. The game’s version of the events takes place on the map with 1530 hexes. The key part of the scenario is naval warfare. You’ll be commanding warships, launching landings and managing coastal artillery – all packed with new gameplay mechanics. This makes ‘Operation Weserübung’ the most complex game scenario to date, with battles raging on land, at sea and in the air.

Detailed patch notes:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/769950/announcements/detail/1673528978323882706

notes.title: The detailed patch notes for the upcoming Panzer Strategy update
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/RPtBQqV.jpg
In the previous post we’ve talked about the gameplay features of the upcoming update. Here is the detailed patch notes:

•	Overall performance improvements.
•	The damage calculation algorithm is refined.
•	The settings menu is now available. You can tune performance, audio settings and game settings (including scrolling speed, unit speed and hexagon glowing). 
•	A new tutorial.
•	New pop-up messages with unit skills descriptions and current game events.
•	Hotkeys list.
•	New background music.
•	New warships' mechanics, all their systems are rebalanced.
•	New AI scripts, event triggers, and secondary scenario objectives.
•	AI in now better operating with ground forces.
•	Refined troops deployment via rail, navy and air transports.
•	New animations for barrel and turret movements as well as the whole unit rotation.
•	"Happy moments" refined, the camera takes multiple attacks into account now.
•	All tanks are rebalanced. Their 3D models are refined. Tank barrels types are changed.
•	New and improved unit assets for more realistic and smooth movement animation.
•	Refined environment objects colliders. New mechanics for choosing an object on the map.
•	All towed units now move on 1 hexagon without embarking via ground transport.
•	Coastal batteries are added. They can be captured by ground forces.
•	New "home" command for aircraft (aircraft automatically goes to the nearest allied airfield).
•	The right UI panel is refined for a better unit stats indication and airfield conditions.
•	New UI for unit management (leveling up, attaches, upgrading etc) and characteristics.
•	Various minor visual improvements and fixes.
•	Various fixes for technical issues.
